statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let N be the ordinary integer binary99x231 incidence matrix containing every actual triangle exactly once. The finite group Z^99/NZ^231 is killed by30. There exists an ordinary integer231-vector w with Nw=j_99 and sum(w)=33. Every such w has odd squared norm at least33; squared norm33 holds exactly for a0/1 indicator of33 pairwise vertex-disjoint actual triangles partitioning all99 points. The equality case, a positive exact cover, a nonconstant left kernel and target existence or exclusion are not asserted.
